correctness.rationale: Exact first-event survival integration gives the stated J_A; symbolic differentiation independently confirmed J_A prime and the baseline \(A/400+16\). Four signed derivative values and a two-Rolle exponential-polynomial root-count bound force exactly three simple critical times for every \(A\in[100,500]\). Elementary endpoint bounds and the strictly positive envelope derivative prove a unique changeover. The checker passes 5199 diagnostic assertions. No numerical approximation is used as a universal proof.

value.rationale: Provides a motivated exact two-wave counterexample to unimodality and continuity assumptions for a single waning intervention, an exhaustive three-stationary-date count and a unique discontinuous global optimizer crossover.
